title: Prototyping as Leadership: How a CTO Ships with AI Agents — Hursh Agrawal, The Browser Company
talk_summary: A CTO describes using overnight autonomous coding-agent runs (setup at 5pm, agent works 4-8h, morning review) to ship 2-10 PRs/week despite a manager schedule. Key mechanisms: a co-work agent that mines Slack/Notion/Jira to build a giant context prompt, test-first + computer-use verification, clean-subagent AI code review, and hill-climbing on eval sets built from feedback JSON dumps.

takeaways.technique: Co-work agent pre-digests context into a giant prompt
takeaways.what_they_do: Before an overnight run, a Slack/Notion/Jira-connected agent does ~20 min of research and emits one large prompt containing business context, trade-offs, prior attempts, and goals, which is pasted into the coding agent.
takeaways.evidence_quote: go and do like 20 minutes of research and go dig through all of Slack and Notion and everything else and come up with a cloud code prompt

takeaways.technique: Test-first + computer-use end-to-end verification in the same run
takeaways.what_they_do: Instructs the agent to write tests first (because post-hoc tests are sloppy), then drive the real UI via computer use to confirm the flow matches business context, then get CI green before morning.
takeaways.evidence_quote: hey write the tests first so they capture what you do ... if they write tests afterwards, they're a little sloppish

takeaways.technique: Clean-subagent AI code review inside the run
takeaways.what_they_do: After finishing, the agent runs an AI code-review skill in a fresh subagent (no shared context) and fixes the findings, then resolves every bot comment and CI check autonomously.
takeaways.evidence_quote: run this AI code review skill in a clean sub agent, and then fix those things

takeaways.technique: Feedback-button JSON dumps → auto-built eval set → overnight hill climb
takeaways.what_they_do: Adds a feedback button to LLM features, saves JSON dumps (system prompt, inputs, feedback), then has the agent convert 10-30 dumps into an eval set and hill-climb a harness overnight, explicitly told not to overfit.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Turn this into an eval set ... build a harness that runs this call against the evals and hill climbs until the score goes up

takeaways.technique: Overnight long-scope autonomous run with morning report
takeaways.what_they_do: At 5pm sets up one large-scope run (feature, eval optimization, even model training) with 'don't ask me questions, leave a report on trade-offs'; morning block reviews and tests output.

takeaways.technique: Provisioned sandbox with scoped credentials, never prod
takeaways.what_they_do: For heavy/risky runs (e.g. model training) gives the agent AWS access to provision a sandbox, pick GPU/EC2, train, test, deprovision — explicitly not prod — and report hosting plan.
takeaways.evidence_quote: give me a provision sandbox do not give it prod that's not a good idea ... pick the right GPU and EC2 cluster
